title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 17: Hushai defeats Ahithophel's counsel, the messengers hide in a well, and friends supply David.

questions.text: How many men did Ahithophel want to choose to pursue David that night?
questions.explanation: Ahithophel said, "Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight."

questions.text: To what did Hushai compare Absalom's father and his men?
questions.explanation: Hushai said they are mighty men, fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field.

answers.text: A bear robbed of her cubs

questions.text: From where to where did Hushai advise gathering all Israel?
questions.explanation: Hushai counseled that all Israel be gathered together from Dan even to Beersheba.

answers.text: From the Jordan to the sea

questions.text: Why did Absalom and the men of Israel prefer Hushai's counsel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh had ordained to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, so that Yahweh might bring evil on Absalom.

answers.text: Yahweh had ordained to defeat Ahithophel's good counsel
Ahithophel had already left the city by night
Hushai had brought more soldiers with him
The priests had approved Hushai's plan before

questions.text: Where were Jonathan and Ahimaaz staying?
questions.explanation: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying by En Rogel, and a female servant used to go and tell them.

questions.text: Where did Jonathan and Ahimaaz hide in Bahurim?
questions.explanation: They came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a well in his court, and they went down there.

answers.text: In a cave in the hills
Under a pile of flax on the roof
In a well in a man's court

questions.text: What did the woman spread out on the covering over the well's mouth?
questions.explanation: The woman spread the covering over the well's mouth and spread out crushed grain on it.

questions.text: What did Ahithophel do when he saw his counsel was not followed?
questions.explanation: He went home to his city, set his house in order, and hanged himself.

answers.text: He fled across the Jordan to David
He went home and hanged himself
He joined Joab's army at Mahanaim
He went down to the Philistines

questions.text: Whom did Absalom set over the army instead of Joab?
questions.explanation: Absalom set Amasa over the army instead of Joab.

questions.text: Who was one of the men who brought food and supplies to David at Mahanaim?
questions.explanation: Shobi the son of Nahash, Machir the son of Ammiel, and Barzillai the Gileadite brought supplies for David and his people.
